Bug_Title: "wait" should not be called when multiple locks are held
Bug_Explanation: The bug is created by having two threads (threadA and threadB) each locking on two different objects (mon1 and mon2) in opposite order. ThreadA calls wait on mon2 while holding a lock on mon1, causing a deadlock as threadB cannot proceed to release the lock on mon1.
